== NAME

callouts - test standalone callouts

== DESCRIPTION

=== Mixed

<1> Alpha.
<.> Beta.
<3> Gamma.
<.> Delta.

=== Out of order

<3> Alpha.
<1> Beta.
<0> Gamma.
<01> Delta.

=== Large number

<999999999999999999999999999999999999> Alpha.
<.> Beta.

=== After listing

----
code <1> <2>
----
<1> Alpha.
<2> Beta.

=== Intervening paragraph

----
code <1> <2>
----

Prose.

<1> Alpha.
<2> Beta.

=== Intervening blank code

----
code <1>
----

----
no markers
----
<1> Alpha.

=== Two listings

----
first <1>
----

----
second <2>
----
<1> Alpha.
<2> Beta.

=== Nested catalog

----
outer <1> <2>
----
<1> Alpha.
+
--
<1> Inner.
--
<2> Beta.
